```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Dataset of nearest stars to Earth
stars_data <- tibble(
  name = c("Earth (Sun)", "Proxima Centauri", "Alpha Centauri A", "Alpha Centauri B",
           "Barnard's Star", "Wolf 359", "Lalande 21185", "Sirius A", 
           "Luyten 726-8", "Ross 154", "Ross 248", "Epsilon Eridani", 
           "61 Cygni", "Procyon", "Tau Ceti", "Kapteyn's Star"),
  dist_ly = c(0, 4.25, 4.37, 4.37, 5.96, 7.86, 8.31, 8.66, 8.73, 9.70, 10.30, 10.50, 11.41, 11.46, 11.91, 12.83),
  angle_deg = c(0, 45, 55, 65, 105, 145, 175, 210, 245, 275, 305, 325, 345, 130, 80, 225),
  type = c("G-type (Sun / Earth)", "Red Dwarf (M-type)", "Yellow Dwarf (G-type)", "Orange Dwarf (K-type)",
           "Red Dwarf (M-type)", "Red Dwarf (M-type)", "Red Dwarf (M-type)", "White Star (A-type)",
           "Binary Red Dwarf", "Red Dwarf (M-type)", "Red Dwarf (M-type)", "Orange Dwarf (K-type)",
           "Binary K-type", "White-Yellow (F-type)", "Yellow Dwarf (G-type)", "Red Subdwarf"),
  details = c(
    "Our home planetary system and solar neighborhood center.",
    "The closest known star to the Sun. Hosts the Earth-sized exoplanet Proxima b.",
    "Very similar in mass and luminosity to our Sun; primary member of the Alpha Centauri system.",
    "Slightly smaller and cooler than our Sun; companion in the Alpha Centauri system.",
    "Known for having the highest proper motion (apparent speed across the sky) of any star.",
    "A very faint red dwarf star made famous in science fiction (like Star Trek).",
    "One of the brightest red dwarf stars visible from Earth (in Ursa Major).",
    "The brightest star visible in Earth's night sky, also known as the Dog Star.",
    "A flare star system that occasionally undergoes dramatic temporary bursts of brightness.",
    "A young, highly active red dwarf flare star located in Sagittarius.",
    "In about 33,000 years, will briefly become our closest neighboring star.",
    "A nearby star with rings of cosmic dust and suspected orbiting gas giant planets.",
    "First star to have its distance reliably measured using stellar parallax in 1838.",
    "The eighth-brightest star in the night sky, with a faint white dwarf companion.",
    "A stable Sun-like star frequently studied in searches for habitable exoplanets.",
    "An ancient halo star believed to originate from a dwarf galaxy merged into the Milky Way."
  )
) |> 
  mutate(
    x = dist_ly * cos(angle_deg * pi / 180),
    y = dist_ly * sin(angle_deg * pi / 180),
    # HTML summary formatted for the side box
    summary_html = paste0(
      "<h3 style='color: navy; margin-top: 0;'>", name, "</h3>",
      "<p><strong>Distance:</strong> ", dist_ly, " light-years</p>",
      "<p><strong>Type:</strong> ", type, "</p>",
      "<p style='line-height: 1.5;'>", details, "</p>"
    ),
    tooltip = paste0(name, "\nDistance: ", dist_ly, " ly\nType: ", type)
  )

# Interactive scatter plot with plotly
fig <- plot_ly(
  stars_data,
  x = ~x,
  y = ~y,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers+text",
  text = ~name,
  textposition = "top center",
  hoverinfo = "text",
  hovertext = ~tooltip,
  customdata = ~summary_html,
  marker = list(
    size = ifelse(stars_data$name == "Earth (Sun)", 13, 8),
    color = ifelse(stars_data$name == "Earth (Sun)", "#0d47a1", "#d84315"),
    line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 1)
  )
)

# Add dashed concentric distance rings (5, 10, 15 light years)
ring_shapes <- list()
for (r in c(5, 10, 15)) {
  ring_shapes[[length(ring_shapes) + 1]] <- list(
    type = "circle",
    xref = "x", yref = "y",
    x0 = -r, y0 = -r, x1 = r, y1 = r,
    line = list(color = "#b0bec5", dash = "dash", width = 1),
    layer = "below"
  )
}

fig <- fig |> 
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Nearby Stars Relative to Earth (Light-Years)", font = list(color = "navy", size = 16)),
    shapes = ring_shapes,
    xaxis = list(title = "Distance (Light-Years)", zeroline = FALSE, range = c(-16, 16)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Distance (Light-Years)", zeroline = FALSE, range = c(-16, 16), scaleanchor = "x", scaleratio = 1),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(t = 50, b = 40, l = 40, r = 20)
  ) |> 
  onRender("
    function(el) {
      el.on('plotly_click', function(d) {
        if (d.points && d.points.length > 0) {
          var info = d.points[0].customdata;
          if (info) {
            document.getElementById('star-summary').innerHTML = info;
          }
        }
      });
    }
  ")

fig
```

<div id="star-summary" style="padding: 16px; border: 2px solid navy; border-radius: 8px; background-color: #f8f9fa; min-height: 250px; margin-top: 50px;">
  <h4 style="color: navy; margin-top: 0;">Star Information</h4>
  <p><em>Click any star on the graph to display its summary here!</em></p>
</div>
:::
:::

<div style="margin-top: 35px; padding: 22px; border: 2px solid navy; border-radius: 8px; background-color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);">
  <h3 style="color: navy; margin-top: 0;">Star Similarity Calculator</h3>
  <p style="margin-bottom: 20px;">Choose two stars to compare how similar they are based on <strong>size</strong>, <strong>temperature</strong>, <strong>color</strong>, <strong>brightness</strong>, <strong>chemical composition</strong>, and <strong>life cycle stage</strong>:</p>

  <div style="display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; margin-bottom: 20px;">
    <div>
      <label for="star1-select" style="font-weight: bold; color: navy;">First Star:</label><br>
      <select id="star1-select" style="padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 15px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"></select>
    </div>
    <div>
      <label for="star2-select" style="font-weight: bold; color: navy;">Second Star:</label><br>
      <select id="star2-select" style="padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 15px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"></select>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; color: navy; padding-bottom: 4px;">
        Similarity Score: <span id="similarity-score" style="color: #d84315;">--%</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="similarity-details" style="font-size: 14px; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #e9ecef;">
    Loading stars...
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const starTraits = {
  "Earth (Sun)": { size: 1.0, temp: 5778, color: "Yellow", brightness: 1.0, compVal: 1.0, composition: "Solar standard (1.0x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence" },
  "Proxima Centauri": { size: 0.15, temp: 3042, color: "Red", brightness: 0.0017, compVal: 1.2, composition: "Metal-rich (1.2x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence (Red Dwarf)" },
  "Alpha Centauri A": { size: 1.22, temp: 5790, color: "Yellow", brightness: 1.52, compVal: 1.3, composition: "Metal-rich (1.3x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence" },
  "Alpha Centauri B": { size: 0.86, temp: 5260, color: "Orange", brightness: 0.50, compVal: 1.3, composition: "Metal-rich (1.3x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence" },
  "Barnard's Star": { size: 0.20, temp: 3134, color: "Red", brightness: 0.0035, compVal: 0.4, composition: "Metal-poor (0.4x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence (Red Dwarf)" },
  "Wolf 359": { size: 0.16, temp: 2800, color: "Red", brightness: 0.0014, compVal: 0.5, composition: "Metal-poor (0.5x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence (Red Dwarf)" },
  "Lalande 21185": { size: 0.39, temp: 3828, color: "Red", brightness: 0.025, compVal: 0.6, composition: "Metal-poor (0.6x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence (Red Dwarf)" },
  "Sirius A": { size: 1.71, temp: 9940, color: "White", brightness: 25.4, compVal: 2.0, composition: "Metal-rich (2.0x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence" },
  "Luyten 726-8": { size: 0.14, temp: 2670, color: "Red", brightness: 0.0006, compVal: 0.5, composition: "Metal-poor (0.5x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence (Red Dwarf)" },
  "Ross 154": { size: 0.24, temp: 3120, color: "Red", brightness: 0.0038, compVal: 0.6, composition: "Metal-poor (0.6x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence (Red Dwarf)" },
  "Ross 248": { size: 0.16, temp: 2799, color: "Red", brightness: 0.0018, compVal: 0.5, composition: "Metal-poor (0.5x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence (Red Dwarf)" },
  "Epsilon Eridani": { size: 0.74, temp: 5084, color: "Orange", brightness: 0.34, compVal: 0.8, composition: "Moderate metal-poor (0.8x)", stage: "Main Sequence" },
  "61 Cygni": { size: 0.67, temp: 4526, color: "Orange", brightness: 0.15, compVal: 0.6, composition: "Metal-poor (0.6x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence" },
  "Procyon": { size: 2.05, temp: 6530, color: "Yellow-White", brightness: 6.93, compVal: 1.0, composition: "Solar standard (1.0x iron)", stage: "Subgiant" },
  "Tau Ceti": { size: 0.79, temp: 5344, color: "Yellow", brightness: 0.52, compVal: 0.4, composition: "Metal-poor (0.4x iron)", stage: "Main Sequence" },
  "Kapteyn's Star": { size: 0.29, temp: 3550, color: "Red", brightness: 0.012, compVal: 0.1, composition: "Very metal-poor halo star (0.1x)", stage: "Subdwarf" }
};

const colorRanks = { "Red": 1, "Orange": 2, "Yellow": 3, "Yellow-White": 4, "White": 5 };

function computeSimilarity(s1, s2) {
  if (s1 === s2) return { total: 100, sSize: 100, sTemp: 100, sColor: 100, sBright: 100, sComp: 100, sStage: 100 };
  const d1 = starTraits[s1];
  const d2 = starTraits[s2];

  // 1. Size similarity (ratio scale)
  const sSize = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(Math.log10(d1.size / d2.size)) / 2) * 100;

  // 2. Temperature similarity
  const sTemp = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(d1.temp - d2.temp) / Math.max(d1.temp, d2.temp)) * 100;

  // 3. Color similarity (spectral step distance)
  const stepDiff = Math.abs((colorRanks[d1.color] || 3) - (colorRanks[d2.color] || 3));
  const sColor = Math.max(0, 1 - stepDiff / 4) * 100;

  // 4. Brightness / Luminosity similarity (logarithmic scale)
  const sBright = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(Math.log10(d1.brightness / d2.brightness)) / 5) * 100;

  // 5. Chemical composition similarity
  const sComp = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(d1.compVal - d2.compVal) / 2) * 100;

  // 6. Life cycle stage similarity
  let sStage = 20;
  if (d1.stage === d2.stage) sStage = 100;
  else if (d1.stage.includes("Main Sequence") && d2.stage.includes("Main Sequence")) sStage = 80;
  else if (d1.stage.includes("Sub") || d2.stage.includes("Sub")) sStage = 50;

  const total = Math.round((sSize + sTemp + sColor + sBright + sComp + sStage) / 6);
  return { total, sSize: Math.round(sSize), sTemp: Math.round(sTemp), sColor: Math.round(sColor), sBright: Math.round(sBright), sComp: Math.round(sComp), sStage: Math.round(sStage) };
}

function updateComparison() {
  const sel1 = document.getElementById("star1-select").value;
  const sel2 = document.getElementById("star2-select").value;
  if (!sel1 || !sel2) return;

  const res = computeSimilarity(sel1, sel2);
  document.getElementById("similarity-score").textContent = res.total + "%";

  const d1 = starTraits[sel1];
  const d2 = starTraits[sel2];

  document.getElementById("similarity-details").innerHTML = `
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="border-bottom: 2px solid #ccc; color: navy;">
          <th style="padding: 6px;">Trait</th>
          <th style="padding: 6px;">${sel1}</th>
          <th style="padding: 6px;">${sel2}</th>
          <th style="padding: 6px;">Match</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding: 6px;"><strong>Size (Radius):</strong></td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d1.size} R☉</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d2.size} R☉</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px; color: #2e7d32; font-weight: bold;">${res.sSize}%</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding: 6px;"><strong>Temperature:</strong></td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d1.temp.toLocaleString()} K</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d2.temp.toLocaleString()} K</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px; color: #2e7d32; font-weight: bold;">${res.sTemp}%</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding: 6px;"><strong>Color:</strong></td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d1.color}</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d2.color}</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px; color: #2e7d32; font-weight: bold;">${res.sColor}%</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding: 6px;"><strong>Brightness:</strong></td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d1.brightness} L☉</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d2.brightness} L☉</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px; color: #2e7d32; font-weight: bold;">${res.sBright}%</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding: 6px;"><strong>Composition:</strong></td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d1.composition}</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d2.composition}</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px; color: #2e7d32; font-weight: bold;">${res.sComp}%</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="padding: 6px;"><strong>Life Stage:</strong></td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d1.stage}</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px;">${d2.stage}</td>
          <td style="padding: 6px; color: #2e7d32; font-weight: bold;">${res.sStage}%</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const sel1 = document.getElementById("star1-select");
  const sel2 = document.getElementById("star2-select");
  const names = Object.keys(starTraits);

  names.forEach((name, i) => {
    sel1.add(new Option(name, name, false, i === 0));
    sel2.add(new Option(name, name, false, i === 2)); // Defaults to Alpha Centauri A
  });

  sel1.addEventListener("change", updateComparison);
  sel2.addEventListener("change", updateComparison);
  updateComparison();
});
</script>
